Game Engine

Live calculator v1.9 for a musical-chairs style elimination game. Before every round, enter the real number of players still in the game — optionally set the target survivor count for that round, and optionally lock the players-per-spotlight group size — then press Recalculate Plan. The engine will rebuild the remaining route toward the final target.
Tip: before each round starts, type the actual number of players still active into that round’s “Players starting this round” box. If you need a specific number left after that round, fill in “Target after round”. If you want to force solos, pairs, trios, fours, or fives, fill in “Players / spotlight”, then press Recalculate Plan.
